purpose: Record the origin, hash and verified behaviour of every reused artefact in software/fixed_model, as required by docs/NEXT_TASK_CLAUDE_FIXED_POINT.md section 3.

reused.written_by: Claude Code during the FFT reuse review (docs/reviews/FFT_REUSE_REVIEW.md section 2.2)
reused.derived_from: Read-only analysis of D:/2610_MFCC/reference_code/previous_fft/rtl/** only. Not derived from the previous project's MATLAB model.
reused.fixed_configuration: data signed 16 bit F15; twiddle signed 16 bit F15 from twiddle_1024_w16.mem; Type-I growth 1 bit (16->17); Type-II growth 1 bit (17->18); twiddle product 35 bit accumulated then >>15 to 18 bit; complete-group shift >>2 to 16 bit; trailing unpaired Type-I shift >>1 to 16 bit. Total reduction S = log2 N, so S = 9 at N = 512.
reused.rounding_behaviour: Every bit-reducing boundary uses convergent rounding (ties to even), matching rtl/common/fixed_round_shift.sv with ROUND_CONVERGENT=1.
reused.overflow_behaviour: WRAP, not saturate. rtl/common/fixed_round_shift.sv:69 keeps only the low OUT_W bits; line 72 only detects the lost sign extension. The model reproduces the wrap and returns a sticky per-frame overflow flag.
reused.output_order: fft_fixed() returns bit-reversed bin order (core output). fft_fixed_natural() returns natural bin order, matching rtl/reorder/natural_reorder_pingpong.sv.
verification_evidence: Twiddle ROM independently recomputed from cos/sin(-2*pi*a/1024) in Q1.15 with ties-to-even and coefficient saturation: all 1024 entries match.
Bit-exact against the previous project's own Phase 6 expected vectors (5 cases, N=16 and N=1024): 0 mismatches.

Bit-exact against RTL simulation of fft_stream_top in 29 scenarios under Vivado 2020.2 and 2024.2: 22720 out_valid beats, 0 mismatches, byte-identical CSV across both tool versions. See D:/2610_MFCC/build/claude-review-2024_2/logs/RESULTS_2024_2.txt.
not_verified: No board execution of the FFT exists. See docs/reviews/FFT_REUSE_REVIEW.md section 2.7.
N = 8 and N = 32 were never simulated; N=64/128/1024 have 1 scenario each and N=256 has 2.
reused.modification_policy: Reused verbatim. Not rewritten for style. docs/RTL_CODING_RULES.md section 1 E-FFT scope applies to the RTL it models.

reused.format: 1024 lines, 8 hex digits each, packed {real[15:0], imag[15:0]}, signed Q1.15
reused.content: W_1024^a = exp(-j*2*pi*a/1024), convergent rounding, coefficient-only saturation so +1.0 becomes 32767
reused.note: The reference_code original is unmodified. This repository copy exists so the integer model is reproducible from the repository alone.

read_only_inputs.purpose: Frozen float64 reference artefacts read but never written by this work.
